about.label: About NAFEIZ
about.title: Your Trusted Bridge Between China and the Arab World
about.story: NAFEIZ Trade Co.,  is a China-based trading, sourcing, and logistics company dedicated to connecting Chinese manufacturers with businesses across the Arab world. We built NAFEIZ on a simple belief: trade should be transparent, reliable, and built on real partnerships — not transactions.
about.story2: From our base in China, we work closely with factories, markets, and suppliers to find the right products at the right prices. Then we handle the logistics, quality control, documentation, and delivery so our clients can focus on growing their businesses back home.
about.whoWeAre: We are a team of trade professionals, inspectors, and logistics specialists who understand both the Chinese market and the needs of Arab buyers. We speak your language — literally and figuratively.
about.positioningText: Located at the heart of global manufacturing, NAFEIZ gives Arab businesses direct access to China's vast supplier network without the barriers of distance, language, or trust.
about.visionText: To become the most trusted gateway for trade between China and the Arab world, making cross-border commerce simple, transparent, and accessible to every business.
about.missionText: To empower Arab businesses by sourcing quality products from China, managing every step of the supply chain, and delivering excellence — from the factory floor to the customer's door.
about.statsSubtitle: A clear view of the markets and trade work we support.
about.ctaTitle: Ready to start trading with China?
about.ctaText: Let NAFEIZ be your partner on the ground. Tell us what you need and we'll handle the rest.

services.label: What We Do
services.title: 14 Services. One Complete Trade Solution.
services.subtitle: From the first inquiry to the final delivery, NAFEIZ manages every detail of your trade with China.

1.title: Rapid Client Response
1.description: Fast, clear communication in your language. We respond to inquiries quickly and keep you informed at every stage.

2.title: Sourcing Reliable Suppliers
2.description: We search China's vast market to find trusted manufacturers that match your quality, budget, and timeline.

3.title: Logistics Services
3.description: End-to-end shipping, customs clearance, and delivery — by sea, air, or land — to your destination.

4.title: Factory & Market Visits
4.description: We visit factories and wholesale markets on your behalf to verify suppliers and inspect production capacity.

5.title: Supplier Negotiation
5.description: We negotiate prices, terms, and conditions with suppliers to get you the best possible deal.

6.title: Factory Contracting
6.description: We handle contracts with factories, ensuring clear terms, timelines, and quality standards are locked in.

7.title: Sample Requests
7.description: We request and evaluate product samples so you can verify quality before committing to bulk orders.

8.title: Design Team Support
8.description: Our design team helps with product customization, packaging, and branding to fit your market.

9.title: Purchase Order Follow-up
9.description: We track your orders through production, keeping schedules on track and issues flagged early.

10.title: Quality Inspection
10.description: Pre-shipment inspections verify product quality, quantity, and packaging before goods leave China.

11.title: Digital Platforms
11.description: We leverage digital platforms and tools to streamline sourcing, ordering, and tracking for our clients.

12.title: Payment Arrangements
12.description: We arrange secure payment terms with suppliers, protecting your funds and ensuring smooth transactions.

13.title: Certificate Preparation
13.description: We prepare and verify the certificates and documents required for customs and compliance in your country.

14.title: Client Status Updates
14.description: We keep you updated with regular reports on order status, shipping progress, and any developments.

countries.label: Markets We Serve
countries.title: Connecting China with the Arab World
countries.subtitle: NAFEIZ serves businesses across the Arab region, bridging cultures, languages, and markets.

egypt.name: Egypt
egypt.description: One of the largest markets in the Arab world, with growing demand for Chinese goods across textiles, electronics, and industrial supplies.
egypt.trade: Major import categories include machinery, textiles, and consumer goods. Cairo and Alexandria serve as key distribution hubs.

libya.name: Libya
libya.description: A rebuilding market with strong demand for construction materials, equipment, and consumer products.
libya.trade: Key import needs include building materials, vehicles, and industrial equipment to support reconstruction.

saudi.name: Saudi Arabia
saudi.description: The largest economy in the region, with diversified import needs driven by Vision 2030 and large-scale development projects.
saudi.trade: Major imports include electronics, machinery, construction materials, and consumer goods. Jeddah and Riyadh are primary hubs.

algeria.name: Algeria
algeria.description: A growing North African market with demand for industrial equipment, consumer goods, and agricultural products.
algeria.trade: Key imports include machinery, vehicles, and consumer products, with Algiers and Oran as main ports.

whyNafeiz.title: A Partner You Can Trust on the Ground in China
whyNafeiz.subtitle: We are not intermediaries. We are your team in China — managing every detail so you don't have to.

whyNafeiz.visualText: Sourcing, quality control, and delivery under one partner.
whyNafeiz.feature1Text: We visit factories, attend markets, and verify suppliers in person — so you don't have to travel.
whyNafeiz.feature2Text: We communicate in Arabic, English, and Chinese, removing the language barrier from your trade.
